text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After completing the fierce race, Eishin Flash is overwhelmed with euphoria and doesn't know what to do with herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once she accepts that these emotions are "right," however, her desire to win the spring Tenno Sho burns ever brighter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Fuji Kiseki looks on with satisfaction as the younger generation grows strong enough to break through the obstacles before them.
